description: This Java class implements a singleton pattern for managing a global NotificationCompat.Builder instance in an Android wearable application. It provides static methods to set and retrieve the builder, enabling consistent notification updates across different parts of the app.

classes.name: GlobalNotificationBuilder
classes.description: A singleton class that maintains a static reference to a NotificationCompat.Builder for use across the application.

methods.name: setNotificationCompatBuilderInstance
methods.description: Assigns a NotificationCompat.Builder instance to the static variable for global access.

methods.name: getNotificationCompatBuilderInstance
methods.description: Retrieves the current global NotificationCompat.Builder instance.
